description: Passwords never leave the run: not in the queue snapshot, not in History, not on Ghostscript's command line.

notes.text: Ghostscript is stood in for by Node under its name, with a preload that records what it was given and writes the output.
The stand-in can't run without an @argfile first (Node reads "-sDEVICE" as its own option), so this job fails; its History row is what counts.
